### Work Order Execution Summary: WO3 — Scopes & Aliases

The implementation and verification for Work Order 3 (`pr-07-v2-storage-wo3`) are complete:

#### 1. Declared Scopes Config
- [`ScopeConfig`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L53-L59): Struct containing `Topics`, `Externals`, and `Procedures` slices of [`DeclaredScope`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L16-L24).
- [`DeclaredScope`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L16-L24): Defines scope metadata including `Name`, `Kind`, `Keywords`, `ToolNames`, `Commands`, and `Description`. Supports YAML unmarshaling for both `tool_names` and `toolNames`.
- [`LoadScopeConfig`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L60-L108): Loads `scopes:` section from `config.yaml`. Returns empty `*ScopeConfig` (no error) if file does not exist, is empty, or the `scopes:` key is omitted.

#### 2. Derived Module Scopes
- [`ModuleScope`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L110-L116): Holds `Name`, `Kind` (`DossierKindModule`), `PathGlobs`, and `Symbols`.
- [`DeriveModuleScopes`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L240-L342):
  - Parses anchor file paths and symbols (handling `file:`, `symbol:`, `path#symbol`, and `path:symbol`).
  - Rolls up directory paths if a directory has $\le 2$ files.
  - Names scopes relative to `internal/`, `cmd/`, or repo root with `-` separators.
  - Returns sorted, deduplicated module scopes.

#### 3. Alias Resolution
- [`AliasMap`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L344-L349): Maps old scope names to replacement scopes from `split` ops.
- [`BuildAliasMap`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L473-L517): Reads ops stream, extracts `split` ops (`op.DossierScope` $\rightarrow$ `new_dossiers`), and populates the alias map.
- [`AliasMap.Resolve`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L418-L444): Traverses alias chains with cycle detection and a maximum depth of 10.

#### 4. Scope Resolver
- [`ScopeResolver`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L519-L525) & [`NewScopeResolver`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L526-L539): Unifies declared scopes, derived modules, and aliases.
- [`ScopeResolver.ResolveScope`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L540-L718): Evaluates in priority order:
  1. Alias matches on anchors/keywords.
  2. Module path prefix / glob / symbol matches.
  3. Declared topic, external tool, and procedure command/keyword matches.
- [`ScopeResolver.AllScopes`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L720-L765): Returns all known scope names deduplicated and sorted.
- [`ScopeResolver.ScopeKind`](file:///Users/mcneillm/Documents/Projects/repo-memory-plugin/internal/core/config/scopes.go#L767-L798): Returns the `DossierKind` for any known scope.
